request: Twenty additional catalog-wide review passes after PR 1286; improve reliable coverage, consolidate owning facts and measure cost.
reviewScope: All 293 rules are evaluated against each review lens. Executable mutations apply only where the language and owner contract support equivalence; no-op and inapplicable cases retain documented boundaries.

passes.evidence: Enumerate every source-owned rule, positive/negative contract, parser, severity and limitation. No new rules or severity changes.
Rename only resolved imported bindings; skip local writes, parameters or source contracts that cannot preserve identity.
AST-equivalent integer spellings preserve the same value; source-comment and prose owners retain their scope.
Unicode escapes are admitted only when the Python AST agrees with the original fixture.
Use ESLint scope references for declaration/read aliases, shorthand properties and exports.
Ordinary decoded literals preserve outcomes; directives and raw JSX attributes are excluded.
No-substitution template values extend existing static-value owners; dynamic templates remain unknown. Textual identity policy retains its representation gate.
Existing argument recognizers strip erased wrappers at their owning boundary; spreads, scope and mutation guards stay intact.
Preserve method identity through literal assertions; typed array-filter provenance uses the receiver symbol when computed-key lookup has no symbol.
Nested non-null/satisfies expressions retain original nodes for binding and type-service lookups.
Calls remain visible through ReturnType assertions in initializers, chains and statements. Type-fact owners are excluded when the transformation changes their contract.
Nested block comments preserve token boundaries and authored outcomes.
Quote lowercase identifier tokens without changing their PostgreSQL identity. Case-sensitive and keyword-like quoted names remain negative controls.

Quoted semicolons do not create statements; quoted punctuation and spaces do not collapse distinct table identities or create duplicate-index advice. Keyword whitespace normalization remains independent of quoted identifier contents.
Decode short and long Unicode escapes at the maintained HCL boundary; invalid escapes, templates and surrogate scalars abstain.
Whole-expression groups preserve declared scalar types; quoted numeric inputs remain absent from diagnostic values.
Escaped JSON spellings preserve decoded values for applicable structured owners. No filename-only findings are introduced.
Preserve source line endings and signatures; TypeScript inert comment/string variants retain negative outcomes outside prose owners.

Reuse erased-expression, static-string, SQL identifier and HCL literal facts. Existing coordinate/duplicate checks and fix convergence fixtures continue to pass. Parenthesis equivalence is exhaustive over 29,524 token sequences.
Verify local immutable pins in fresh bounded processes, compare every diagnostic with multiplicity, measure paired timings/RSS, run all owning suites and make verify, then exact-revision PR CI.

supplementalReproductions: Distinct quoted SQL table names produced one false duplicate-index finding.
An HCL long Unicode escape hid one constant-input finding.
Quoted-semicolon statement and grouped-quoted-input privacy controls were labeled before their owning fixes.
baselineEvidence.fixtureCorrections: JSX raw attributes and directive prologues do not use ordinary decoded-string equivalence. Textual assertion-identity policy retains spelling sensitivity; one Zod type-fact lens is excluded. Two temporary disk-space execution errors were rerun and are not counted as rule gaps.

admission.routing: sarj-ai/code-standards: source/configuration semantics and lint-engine shared facts
admission.failureMode: Equivalent HCL labels/literals, SQL identifiers and erased TypeScript expressions concealed existing diagnostics or produced false orphan, timeout and duplicate-index warnings.
admission.owners: All changes refine existing owners and their shared parsers. Upstream linter configuration cannot fix these custom recognizers.
admission.harm: Current resource/test/API coverage can be bypassed by equivalent source spelling; false diagnostics can advise removing declared inputs or a useful index.
admission.validity: No policy freezes a current filename, constant or repository arrangement; dynamic, foreign, shadowed and type-sensitive states retain existing exclusions.
admission.boundary: Reuse original ESLint AST nodes, scope/type services, bounded SQL scans and the shared HCL parser.
admission.beforeImplementation: All new transformed fixtures and supplemental owning regressions were labeled before their corresponding fixes.
admission.fixPolicy: No new automatic fix is introduced. Existing fix-output and second-pass convergence cases remain in the shared 495-case harness.

regressions.nativeAdditionalCases: Escaped labels, Unicode scalar validation, grouped values, privacy, quoted identifiers/keywords, case-sensitive tables, statement punctuation and multiline keyword/constraint boundaries live in their owning tests.

postReviewAffectedCorpus.scope: All SQL and IaC owners rescanned after the final shared identifier/Unicode refinements using the same pinned manifests.

corpusInspection.classification: Every finding, message and multiplicity is unchanged. Previously calibrated findings are not newly adjudicated as true positives.
corpusInspection.limits: Corpus scans exercise all 164 native owners and 113 TypeScript owners without mandatory type services. Five mandatory type-service owners and all 11 text owners retain typed/authored probes and full owning suites. Private identity, paths, snippets and hashes are omitted.

hclParentheses.recipe: Construct ( as a token repeated N times, true, and ) repeated N times, for N=100,1000,3000; run strip_outer_parentheses five times per size in each fresh baseline/candidate process. Exhaustive equivalence uses all token products of (, ), x of lengths zero through nine.

performance.interpretation: Whole-catalog paired medians do not establish a general speedup. HCL group removal changes from repeated rescanning to one scan; the focused deeply nested stress improves substantially while exhaustive boundary outcomes agree.
performance.protocol: Three fresh baseline/candidate process pairs per family scan the same 100 public-corpus files. HCL reports the first cold call and the median of four warm calls. SQL and IaC owning performance gates also pass.
performance.cacheBounds: SQL/HCL source-fact caches retain 32 entries; line indexing retains one. No path-only cache is added. SQL quote membership uses binary search and the unquoted path avoids rescanning.
performance.memory: Native peak RSS is reported in bytes on macOS; TypeScript RSS is sampled at completion, not claimed as peak.
performance.timingLimit: Local concurrent load influences timings; the claim is limited to algorithmic HCL group removal.

release.immutableTags: Affected versions and exact sibling pins advance. No immutable tag is retargeted.

commands: code-standards --root . maintain rules changes --before origin/main --after HEAD
